extracted.name: Easy Rice Cooker Mac 'n Cheese
extracted.description: This 3-cheese rice cooker mac and cheese recipe is quick and easy to prepare, cooks in just 30 minutes, and always turns out delicious!
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Mix macaroni, broth, and almond milk together in the rice cooker; cook according to the manufacturer's instructions until macaroni is tender yet firm to the bite, 30 to 40 minutes.
Stir Cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese, paprika, salt, and pepper into macaroni mixture until cheeses are melted.
